prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Friday October 16, 2026. Topic: Quantum, space, nuclear, robotics.

Window: Thursday October 15, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Friday October 16, 2026 02:03 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. Anything published after 02:03 ET on Friday October 16, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
Quantum computing (IonQ, Rigetti, D-Wave, Quantum Computing Inc, Infleqtion, IBM, Google), space (SpaceX, Rocket Lab, AST SpaceMobile), nuclear/SMR, eVTOL, robotics/humanoids, drones: technical milestones with figures, contracts, offerings, analyst actions, conferences, and each stock's move including sympathy moves.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **IONQ** — Quantum Computing
- IonQ priced a **$2.0 billion equity offering** comprising **20.5 million common shares at $40**, pre-funded warrants for **29.5 million shares at $40**, and **100 million seven-year warrants exercisable at $69.46**; proceeds are intended for quantum computing, networking, sensing, and security commercialization. (IonQ/company release, Oct. 14–15; publish time not provided)
- Morgan Stanley analyst Joseph Moore lowered IonQ’s price target from **$49 to $43**; the rating was not reported as changed. (Pluang, Oct. 15; publish time not provided)
- IonQ shares fell about **9% to $31.42** in reaction to the financing, while **D-Wave** and **Rigetti** also declined; the cited report did not provide a cutoff-time closing price. (Pluang, Oct. 15; publish time not provided)
- IonQ’s reported Q2 revenue was **$80 million**, up **287% year over year**; no Q2 EPS or consensus comparison was provided. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 15; publish time not provided)

## **RGTI / QBTS** — Quantum Computing
- **Rigetti Computing** rose **3% to $12.09** and **D-Wave Quantum** rose **2% to $12.29** during Oct. 15 trading as quantum-computing shares rebounded; no closing or 02:03 ET prices were provided. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 15; publish time not provided)
- D-Wave, Rigetti, and IonQ were reported as having national-security veterans on their boards, including former Homeland Security Secretary **Kirstjen Nielsen** at D-Wave, former Joint Chiefs Chairman **Gen. Peter Pace** at Rigetti, and former National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency director **Robert Cardillo** at IonQ. (Business Insider, Oct. 15 09:06 ET)

## **RKLB** — Space
- Rocket Lab moved the first flight of its **Neutron** medium-lift reusable rocket to **2027** after finding voids in the carbon-composite layers of the first-stage propellant dome; CEO Peter Beck said the issue was resolved, while cryogenic and hydrostatic testing was expected to continue through **Q1 2027**. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 15 10:06 ET)
- Rocket Lab shares fell approximately **11% to $52.85** in morning trading; the report said the stock had closed at **$59.18** on Oct. 14 after an **8%** decline. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 15 10:06 ET)
- Clear Street cut its price target from **$129 to $105** and retained a **Buy** rating; KeyBanc cut its target from **$135 to $100** and retained **Overweight**; Roth Capital retained **Buy** with a **$110** target. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 15 10:18 ET)

## **SPCX / ASTS** — Space Sympathy Moves
- **SpaceX** shares fell approximately **2% to $148.65**, while **AST SpaceMobile** shares fell approximately **2% to $41.38** during Oct. 15 morning trading as Rocket Lab’s Neutron delay affected space-sector trading. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 15 10:06 ET)
- AST SpaceMobile was reported to be targeting approximately **45 BlueBird satellites in early 2027**, with **45–60 satellites** cited as the level for continuous service in key markets; the company had announced arrival of BlueBirds **14, 15, and 16** at Cape Canaveral without a confirmed launch date. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 15; publish time not provided)
- Piper Sandler reportedly downgraded AST SpaceMobile to **Neutral** and cut its price target to **$54**, citing satellite-launch pace and competition from SpaceX; the report did not provide the prior rating or target. (Pluang, Oct. 15; publish time not provided)
- A report citing satellite-communications consultant Tim Farrar estimated that reaching **60 satellites** could take until **2028**; this was an external estimate, not a company forecast. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 15; publish time not provided)

## **QUCY / ONDS** — Quantum Security and Drones
- Quantum Cyber appointed retired U.S. Army Major General **Alberto C. Rosende** to its board, effective **Oct. 13, 2026**; the appointment was discussed alongside defense-related hiring at Ondas Holdings and IonQ. (Business Insider, Oct. 15 09:06 ET)
- IonQ’s reported chief information officer was **Katie Arrington**, formerly the Department of War’s acting CIO; the source did not identify a new Oct. 15 appointment. (Business Insider, Oct. 15 09:06 ET)
